title: Choose the visual world for your site
question: Here's the direction I'd build, plus a few alternates. Keep it, pick another, or re-roll for a fresh hand.

options.label: The Diploma Folder
options.lineage: Commencement diploma covers, moiré linings, and engraved security-paper certificates
options.thesis: Your site opens like the diploma you're about to earn, with you inside it instead of a certificate.
options.viewport: A brown leather folder fills the screen with your name embossed; it swings open on load to reveal your big portrait on blue lining, with your one-line intro and links on the facing page.
options.risk: If the type is set like a real diploma it turns stiff and formal, so the lettering stays warm and modern and the folder is only the frame.

raised.raise: Brown and blue own whole regions as flat, confident fields, never timid accents on a white page.
No card boxes or divider clutter: hierarchy comes from scale and weight alone.
Hover a job or project and the rest gently dim, so one thing is in focus at a time.
One state drives everything: the graduation tassel moves as you change tabs, and the page's accent follows it.
Every role and milestone carries a precise date set in tabular figures, like a commencement program.

options.label: The Record Sleeve
options.lineage: 1950s–60s jazz LP covers: duotone photos and huge type
options.thesis: You are the album: a duotone portrait and your name set huge, with each tab a track on the back cover.
options.viewport: A square-feeling cover: your photo in blue-and-brown duotone with your name cropped massive across it; nav reads as Side A / Side B.
options.risk: This is where most bold portfolio runs land, so it's effective and confident but familiar.

options.label: The Memory Quilt
options.lineage: Hand-pieced quilts where each block carries a date and a story
options.thesis: Your life as a quilt of chambray-blue and brown patches, each one a job, project, or memory, seamed together with visible stitching.
options.viewport: A grid of fabric-like blocks: your portrait is the center patch, and experience, projects, and grad photos are pieced around it.
options.case: Strong on personality and fits your palette naturally; loses on clarity because recruiters must hunt for the resume.
options.risk: Can tip into 'too busy' or crafty unless held to very few patches.

options.label: Solidarity Silkscreen
options.thesis: One emblematic figure in flat fearless color fields with a repeating type border.
options.viewport: Your portrait as a flat-color emblem, center sheet.
options.risk: Political-poster tone and a red/yellow palette both fight your brief.
options.case: Recruiters don't identify with protest posters, and it overrides your brown/blue.
options.kept: Total commitment to flat color fields.

options.label: Generative Identity
options.thesis: A logo that reseeds itself and recolors the site around it.
options.viewport: Animated mark with a reseed control.
options.risk: Feels like a tech demo, not a person.
options.case: Puts a gimmick in front of you, and you asked for person-first.
options.kept: One state driving the whole page (now the tassel).

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Bitmap text on a black void with drifting star fields.
options.viewport: One line of text over a black void.
options.risk: Dark and techy, which you ruled out.
options.kept: No boxes: rank by scale alone.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Your career as tracks curving out of one collision.
options.case: Off-brief on mood and buries the essentials.
options.kept: Focus one item, dim the rest.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: Rooms lit by a moving sunbeam through the day.
options.viewport: A building section with a traveling beam.
options.risk: Beautiful but has nothing to do with you.
options.case: No recruiter connection, and the metaphor needs explaining.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern personal site, executed impeccably in brown and blue.
canonCard.viewport: Name and headshot hero, top nav tabs, and resume and contact buttons up front.
canonCard.risk: Polished but looks like many other grads' sites by design.
